sources_add.title: Tumandok Indigenous People of Panay et al. vs. Daewoo Engineering and Construction

fields_add.outcome: On 30 January 2026 South Korea's National Contact Point published an initial assessment accepting that complaint and offering the parties mediation, while holding that only issues arising after Daewoo's September 2018 contract, such as the forced relocation of residents, could be linked to the company's business activities.

complaint_h.k: ncp:Tumandok Indigenous People of Panay et al. vs. Daewoo Engineering and Construction

sources_add.title: KTNC Watch et al vs Daewoo

fields_add.outcome: An earlier complaint over the same project, KTNC Watch et al vs Daewoo, was rejected by South Korea's National Contact Point, which held that Daewoo E&C “was not in a position to affect the problems that occurred before the conclusion of the construction contract”.

complaint_h.k: ncp:KTNC Watch et al vs Daewoo

sources_add.title: KTNC Watch et al vs KEXIM

fields_add.outcome: The companion 2018 complaint, KTNC Watch et al vs KEXIM, was also rejected by South Korea's National Contact Point, which held that the concessional loan for a public project promoted by the Philippine government was not an international investment or a commercial activity, so the Guidelines did not apply to the bank.

complaint_h.k: ncp:KTNC Watch et al vs KEXIM

sources_add.title: Forum Suape et al. vs. Atradius Dutch State Business

fields_add.outcome: The Dutch National Contact Point accepted the complaint against Atradius DSB in December 2015 and clarified in its final statement that export credit services fall within the scope of the Guidelines and that Atradius DSB, while it had not caused or contributed to the impacts, was directly linked to them and had to use its leverage to prevent and mitigate the harms from the dredging.

complaint_h.k: ncp:Forum Suape et al. vs. Atradius Dutch State Business

sources_add.title: Forum Suape et al. vs. Van Oord

fields_add.outcome: The Brazilian National Contact Point accepted the complaint against Van Oord in August 2015, rejected the parallel complaint against Complexo Industrial Portuário Eraldo Gueiros on the ground that it is not a multinational enterprise, and closed the Van Oord instance with a final statement on 5 June 2020 noting the agreements reached in a separate mediation, among them the feasibility of artificial reef systems and of a public health system for the local fishing communities.

complaint_h.k: ncp:Forum Suape et al. vs. Van Oord

sources_add.title: Maurice Blackburn Lawyers and Macquarie University’s Business & Human Rights Access to Justice Lab vs. South32 Ltd

fields_add.outcome: On 14 August 2026 the Australian National Contact Point partially accepted a complaint filed in October 2025 by Maurice Blackburn Lawyers and Macquarie University's Business and Human Rights Access to Justice Lab, taking up the issues about South32's due diligence when it divested from Cerro Matoso S.A. and rejecting the rest, including the issues about the mine's operations in Colombia and the status of Colombian court orders.

The existing complaint record carries its own coordinates (11.1225, 122.538) rather than the case's (11.1411, 122.5036); pre-existing, and outside the fields this round may touch. complaint_h true is right: harm on the ground is recorded by the case (nine killed, about 500 displaced at this operation) and the complaint records involuntary resettlement with inadequate compensation for farmland and cemeteries, which is harm and not only a due-diligence shortfall. The Korean NCP's rejection goes to the respondent's link, not to where the events happened, and the writer dealt with that in why. The existing record carries ap: true although the harvested status is Rejected and the NCP rejected the complaint at initial assessment; by the brief's definition ap should be false. The record is pre-existing and this round may not touch it, so a later round should fix ap on this record and on ncp:KTNC Watch et al vs KEXIM.

Same event as the Daewoo pair, filed the same day against the other respondent and cross-listed by OECD Watch under 'Related complaints'; kept as a separate record and a separate link, as the brief requires. complaint_h true is right, on the case's nine killed and about 500 displaced. The existing record carries ap: true although the complaint was rejected; pre-existing, flagged for a later round.
